No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. One introduced upper primary-dentition arch retains ten crowns in bilateral order: central incisor, lateral incisor, canine, first molar, second molar. Incisors keep rounded cutting-edge glyphs, canines diamond outlines with one internal circular cusp cue, and molars rounded rectangular crowns. Canine diamonds and their cusp circles are independently enlarged to retain an open material gap; no premolars or third molars are added. Tooth-class shapes and gaps are schematic inventory conventions, not a patient dental impression or clinical cusp anatomy. This single arch is not the full twenty-tooth primary mouth.", "canvas_mm": [170, 190]}, "teaching": "One introduced upper primary-dentition arch retains ten crowns in bilateral order: central incisor, lateral incisor, canine, first molar, second molar. Canine diamonds and their cusp circles are independently enlarged to retain an open material gap; no premolars or third molars are added.
